name: Scenario J: Automated Google Review Request
description: Triggers on a Calendly invitee.created webhook. Waits 48 hours (builtin:Sleep), then calls OpenRouter (Claude claude-sonnet-4-6) to write a personalized 3-sentence review request email body. Sends the email via Resend (white-labeled, from the client's own verified domain). Logs a HubSpot note on the contact. Error route emails env.ADMIN_EMAIL via Resend from env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. CWI AI is never mentioned in client-facing communications. All secrets stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME.
comments:
SCENARIO J — AUTOMATED GOOGLE REVIEW REQUEST

PURPOSE: After a Calendly meeting is booked (invitee.created), wait 48 hours, then send a warm, personalized Google review request email generated by Claude (anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 via OpenRouter). Log the outreach as a HubSpot note. Alert the admin if any step fails.

WHITE-LABEL NOTE: The client-facing email (module 4) MUST send from env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS / env.RESEND_FROM_NAME (the client's own verified domain and sender name). The email body is generated by Claude and must never mention CWI AI, CWI, or any internal brand. The Google Review link is appended from env.GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK so it stays configurable per client without code changes.

SECRETS (all via env.VARIABLE_NAME — never hardcoded):
  env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY      — OpenRouter API key
  env.RESEND_API_KEY          — Resend API key
  env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS     — Verified sender email (client's domain, e.g. hello@clientdomain.com)
  env.RESEND_FROM_NAME        — Sender display name (e.g. "Jane at Acme")
  env.GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK      — Full Google Business review URL for the client
  env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN    — HubSpot Private App token (scopes: contacts.read, notes.write)
  env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS  — Internal CWI alert sender (verified Resend address)
  env.ADMIN_EMAIL             — Admin inbox for internal alerts and error notifications
  env.CLIENT_NAME             — Business display name used in the AI prompt (white-labeled)

FLOW OVERVIEW:
  Module 1 (gateway:CustomWebHook hook 3010) — Calendly invitee.created instant webhook trigger
  Module 2 (builtin:Sleep 172800 s)           — Wait 48 hours before sending
  Module 3 (http:ActionSendData)              — OpenRouter POST — Claude generates email body
  Module 4 (http:ActionSendData)              — Resend POST — sends review request to invitee
  Module 5 (http:ActionSendData)              — HubSpot POST — logs 'Review request sent' note
  Error Handler (http:ActionSendData)         — Resend alert to admin on any failure

TIMEZONE: America/New_York

TESTING: Send a test Calendly webhook payload (invitee.created) to hook 3010. Confirm the 48-hour sleep fires, Claude returns a 3-sentence body, Resend delivers from the correct from address, and HubSpot note appears on the contact. Verify the from address and body contain zero CWI branding.

metadata.note: Module 1: Instant webhook trigger. Listens on Make.com Custom Webhook hook ID 3010 for Calendly invitee.created events. Calendly sends the full event payload including invitee name, email, event type, and scheduled time. In Calendly: Admin > Integrations > Webhooks > add the Make.com webhook URL and subscribe to invitee.created. Key fields used downstream: payload.invitee.name ({{1.payload.invitee.name}}), payload.invitee.email ({{1.payload.invitee.email}}).

Module 2: Sleep 172800 seconds (48 hours / 2 days). Pauses execution so the review request is not sent immediately after booking — it fires after the meeting has presumably taken place. Make.com stores the scenario run and resumes automatically after the delay. Ensure the scenario's max-run time in Make settings accommodates runs longer than 48 hours (Make.com Enterprise plans support long sleeps; confirm your plan).

Module 3: POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions. Uses model anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6. System prompt: 'You write short friendly emails.' User prompt asks Claude to write a personalized 3-sentence review request for {{1.payload.invitee.name}} at {{env.CLIENT_NAME}}. Response body is available at {{3.body.choices[].message.content}} — use {{3.body.choices[0].message.content}} in module 4. env.CLIENT_NAME is the white-labeled business name; env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY authenticates the request.

Module 4: POST https://api.resend.com/emails. FROM '{{env.RESEND_FROM_NAME}} <{{env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS}}>' — client's verified Resend domain. TO {{1.payload.invitee.email}}. SUBJECT 'How did we do? Quick review request'. BODY: Claude-generated 3-sentence email ({{3.body.choices[0].message.content}}) appended with {{env.GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK}} as both a plain-text link and an HTML button. White-labeled: zero CWI AI mentions. env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS must be a verified sending domain in Resend.

Module 5a (inline): POST https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/contacts/search. Finds the HubSpot contact matching {{1.payload.invitee.email}}. Returns {{5.body.results[0].id}} used to associate the note. If no match is found (results array empty), the note POST in module 6 will fail gracefully and the error handler will alert the admin.

Module 6: POST https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/notes. Logs note 'Review request sent — [datetime] ET. Invitee: [name] ([email]). Email sent from [from address]. Google Review link: [link].' associated with the contact found in module 5 (associationTypeId 202 = Contact-to-Note). hs_timestamp uses Unix milliseconds (formatDate now 'x'). env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN must have crm.objects.notes.write scope.

errorHandlers.label: Error Handler — Review Request (Resend alert to admin)

metadata.note: Error Handler (module 7): Catches any failure in modules 2–6 (Sleep, OpenRouter call, Resend send, HubSpot search/note). Sends an internal alert via Resend FROM env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS TO env.ADMIN_EMAIL with invitee details, error message, failed module ID, scenario run ID, and timestamp in America/New_York. This route never fires the client-facing email — manual follow-up is required when this fires.

gateway.label: CWI Calendly Webhook — hook 3010
gateway.note: Custom Webhook module in Make.com. No OAuth connection required — Make.com generates the webhook URL. Paste the URL into Calendly: Admin > Integrations > Webhooks > Add webhook > select invitee.created. Hook ID 3010 must match the ID assigned in Make.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter HTTP connection
openrouter.note: No native Make.com module — uses http:ActionSendData. Authenticated via 'Authorization: Bearer {{env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY}}'. Model: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6. max_tokens: 300, temperature: 0.7.

resend.label: Resend HTTP connection
resend.note: No native Make.com module — uses http:ActionSendData. Authenticated via 'Authorization: Bearer {{env.RESEND_API_KEY}}'. Client-facing email uses env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS (verified sending domain). Internal alerts use env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS.

hubspot.label: HubSpot HTTP connection
hubspot.note: No native Make.com module — uses http:ActionSendData with env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN. Required scopes: crm.objects.contacts.read (module 5), crm.objects.notes.write (module 6). Create via HubSpot: Settings > Private Apps > Create a private app.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: OpenRouter API key. Get from https://openrouter.ai/keys.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key. Get from https://resend.com/api-keys.

RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS.description: Verified sending email address on the client's own domain (e.g. hello@clientdomain.com). Must be verified in Resend. Used for all client-facing outbound email.

RESEND_FROM_NAME.description: Display name for the client-facing sender (e.g. 'Jane at Acme Plumbing'). Never use CWI branding here.

GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK.description: Full Google Business review URL for the client. Get from Google Business Profile > Get more reviews.

CLIENT_NAME.description: White-labeled business display name used in the Claude AI prompt. Never use CWI AI here.

HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: HubSpot Private App access token. Required scopes: crm.objects.contacts.read, crm.objects.notes.write.

CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS.description: Internal verified CWI sender address for admin/error alerts (e.g. alerts@cwiai.net). Must be verified in Resend.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Admin inbox for internal alerts and error notifications (e.g. brian@cwiai.net).

setupInstructions.step1_calendly_webhook: In Calendly: Admin > Integrations > Webhooks > Add webhook. Paste the Make.com Custom Webhook URL for hook ID 3010. Subscribe to the invitee.created event. Test with a booking to confirm the payload arrives in Make.
setupInstructions.step2_openrouter: Set env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY from https://openrouter.ai/keys. The model anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 must be enabled on your OpenRouter account. Review response at {{3.body.choices[0].message.content}}.
setupInstructions.step3_resend: Set env.RESEND_API_KEY. Verify the sender domain for env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS in Resend (Domains > Add domain > add DNS records). Set env.RESEND_FROM_NAME to a friendly client-branded display name. Set env.GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK to the client's Google Business review URL. Verify env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS as a separate CWI sender.
setupInstructions.step4_hubspot: Create a HubSpot Private App (Settings > Integrations > Private Apps > Create) with scopes crm.objects.contacts.read and crm.objects.notes.write. Store the token in env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN. Module 5 searches by invitee email; module 6 posts the note (associationTypeId 202).
setupInstructions.step5_sleep_duration: The builtin:Sleep is set to 172800 seconds (48 hours). Adjust as needed. Confirm your Make.com plan supports long-running scenario pauses — Make.com Enterprise and higher plans support waits beyond 24 hours. Check Make.com plan limits before enabling.
setupInstructions.step6_white_label_check: Before going live, send a test booking and inspect the outbound email from Resend. Confirm: (1) From address is env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS (not any CWI address), (2) From name is env.RESEND_FROM_NAME, (3) email body contains zero CWI AI / CWI branding, (4) Google Review link resolves correctly.
setupInstructions.step7_testing: Full test flow: trigger a Calendly invitee.created webhook manually (use Make.com 'Run once' + a test webhook payload). Confirm: sleep fires, OpenRouter returns a 3-sentence body, Resend delivers, HubSpot note appears on contact, no CWI branding in client email. Optionally test the error route by temporarily breaking the OpenRouter API key and verifying the admin alert fires.
